tagline.en_US: Chrome is the official web browser from Google, built to be fast, secure, and customizable.

description.en_US: Chrome is a web browser developed by Google designed for browsing websites and running web applications. It provides tools for navigating the internet securely with support for multimedia, web standards, and developer utilities. Users can customize their browsing experience with extensions, bookmarks, and personalized configurations.

tips: Copy and paste between your computer and the streamed desktop, including images, works over HTTPS: port 3001 or an HTTPS reverse proxy. Browsers block clipboard access over plain HTTP.
